items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I used to stay with some of the drunk musicians who played very well like Raymond Walters and people like that. Sonny Thompson.

ctx.x: And I used to stay with some of the drunk musicians who played very well like Raymond Walters and people like that. Sonny Thompson. And that I didn’t know I would gorilla off of them (laughs).
Could you tell me, the first lesson you took, what did your mother pay your teacher?
